mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_window_guard(enterprise_id,warehouse_id) VALUES(#{e},#{w}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE warehouse_id=warehouse_id
mapper.select: SELECT closed_before FROM source_window_guard WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE source_window_guard SET closed_before=GREATEST(COALESCE(closed_before,#{cutoff}),#{cutoff}) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO source_reconciliation_window(enterprise_id,warehouse_id,cutoff_id,closed_at,digest) VALUES(#{e},#{w},#{id},#{cutoff},#{digest}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cutoff_id=cutoff_id
mapper.select: SELECT cutoff_id,closed_at,last_command_id,fact_count,digest,state,version FROM source_reconciliation_window WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT c.command_id,c.state,c.posting_id,c.source_execution_id, CAST(JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.payload_json,'$.postingContext'))='OBJECT' AS UNSIGNED) AS has_posting_context, x.physical_qty,x.posted_qty,x.executed_at,c.action FROM source_command c LEFT JOIN source_execution x ON x.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND x.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id AND x.command_id=c.command_id AND x.id=c.source_execution_id WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{e} AND c.warehouse_id=#{w} AND c.created_at < #{cutoff} AND c.command_id > #{after} ORDER BY c.command_id LIMIT 201
mapper.update: UPDATE source_reconciliation_window SET last_command_id=#{after},fact_count=#{count},digest=#{digest},state=#{state},version=version+1 WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND warehouse_id=#{w} AND cutoff_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND state='COLLECTING'
